description: Create a free draft publishing stream owned by the signed-in user for their research, news, or other updates. Supply a plain-text description and add a first post with create_stream_post before publishing with publish_stream. This creates a publishing destination; use existing custom-target tools to configure supported source monitoring or request_stream to request new coverage. Does not configure paid pricing.

apiAccessEnabled.description: Whether external API consumers can subscribe to this stream.

description.description: What the stream publishes, as plain text; Markdown is not rendered.

label.description: Short tag shown on the stream page; empty for none.

name.description: Stream name shown in the catalog and on its page.

streamCategory.description: Topic category; stream list tools can filter by it.

streamType.description: PUBLIC streams are listed in the public catalog once published; PRIVATE streams are visible only to their owner and to users who follow, subscribe to, were invited to, or have organization access to them. update_stream can’t change it.

name: create_stream
title: Create draft stream
